evaluation_factors: Skills Match: How well required skills align with primary > secondary > tertiary strengths
Experience Level: Mid-level is ideal. Junior is fine. Senior in AR/VR is acceptable.
Project Type: Prioritize AR/VR, Unity games, multiplayer servers (Rust), graphics programming (OpenGL/C++), mobile shipping
Budget/Rate: For Upwork: €10–30/hour or reasonable fixed-price. For full-time: ~€50k/year. Flag lowball budgets.
Project Scope: Both full project ownership and SDK/feature contribution are fine. Fixed-price and hourly both acceptable.
Client Quality: Flag vague requirements, unrealistic expectations, no verified payment, spec work. Positive: clear scope, hire history, domain knowledge.
Competition: AR/VR and Rust game server roles have less competition — factor this in positively.
